abstract: In this study, we performed the differential display technique to identify genes specifically expressed in human choriocarcinoma cell lines (JEG-3, JAR and BeWo) and normal placental term cells. Few differences were found among the expression profiles of the three choriocarcinoma cell lines and most of the differentially expressed genes were detected in normal term placenta. A total of 36 cDNA fragments were isolated and analysed. Of these, 19 sequences corresponded to regions in the human genome coding for potential novel genes. We confirmed by RT-PCR, the placental mRNA expression of three selected new human genes, on chromosomes 16q12, 9q32 and 6q22. The other 17 sequences showed high similarity to known human genes (like PSG3, FN1, PAI-2). Interestingly, the functions of five known proteins (from genes IK, TRA-1, HERPUD1, UBA-2, and TRAP240) have not yet been well characterized in placenta tissue. In addition, new alternative spliced mRNAs were detected for IK, TRAP240 and PLAC3 genes. The differential expression of the PAI-2 gene among the choriocarcinoma cell lines was also confirmed. The genes identified in this analysis will be of interest for future studies regarding both a better understanding of the biology of the trophoblast cell and the formation of placental tumors.
abstract_ja: 本研究では、ディファレンシャルディスプレイ法を用いて、ヒト絨毛癌細胞株（JEG-3、JAR、BeWo）および正期産の正常胎盤栄養膜細胞に特異的に発現する遺伝子を同定した。3種の絨毛癌細胞株の発現プロファイルの間にはわずかな差しか認められず、差次的に発現する遺伝子の大部分は正常胎盤で検出された。単離された36のcDNA断片を解析した結果、19の配列はゲノム上の新規遺伝子候補領域に対応した。そのうち3遺伝子（染色体16q12、9q32、6q22）の胎盤におけるmRNA発現をRT-PCRで確認した。残りの17配列は既知遺伝子（PSG3、FN1、PAI-2など）と高い相同性を示した。また、IK、TRAP240、PLAC3遺伝子では新たな選択的スプライシングのmRNAが検出された。PAI-2遺伝子の絨毛癌細胞株間での差次的発現も確認された。本解析で同定された遺伝子は、栄養膜細胞の生物学の理解や胎盤性腫瘍の形成機序の解明に資すると考えられる。
